incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - routing fallback loop detected for /v1/generate. Symptoms: repeated cross-region failovers eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1, spike in 5xx and token latency. Affected customers: 2 high-volume tenants. Oncall: @Ana (pagerduty link: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-2589007)

Ana (oncall): I'm on it. Any idea what changed? saw an infra/config deploy ~02:12 UTC.

Matt (sre): Confirmed — config-schema migration deployed at 02:12 by config-service. There was a deprecated field mapping that got removed but code that reads it fell back to an unexpected default. Seeing a wave of fallback events starting right after the deploy.

Cheng (runtime): Early signal: model-variant selection code got a new "auto-variant" fallback. In low capacity, it picks smallest compatible variant. For some routes that meant switching from gptx-13 (customer pinned) -> gptx-13-mini which is not fully compatible with their prompt shape. That triggers more retries and then region fallback.

Alex (support): Customer ACME sent a ticket at 02:20 UTC: "sudden increase in response errors and truncated outputs; model seems wrong." They included logs showing model id gptx-13-mini while their app pins gptx-13.

Matt (sre): Snippet from the config that caused trouble (from the migrated config):

```json
"routing_policy": {
  "region_preference_v2": ["eu-west-1","us-east-1"],
  "legacy_preferred_variant": "gptx-13-q8_legacy"  // deprecated field name leaked in migration
}
```

Matt (sre): The new schema removes `legacy_preferred_variant`, but the reader now defaults to `auto-variant` when it doesn't find an explicit variant. That default wasn't intended to be global.

Ana (oncall): OK, priority mitigations? We should stop cross-region bouncing first.

Cheng (runtime): Agreed. Two immediate actions I can do now:
1) Turn off cross-region automatic fallback for affected routes (set routing.policies.allow_cross_region_fallback = false)
2) Force variant resolution to prefer stable variants (disable auto-variant) until we fix the schema reader.

Ana (oncall): Do it. Ping when done.

Cheng (runtime): Running commands now:

```
# temporarily disable unsafe fallback
infractl config set routing.policies.allow_cross_region_fallback false --scope=tenant:acme
infractl config set runtime.auto_variant.enabled false --scope=global
```

deploy-bot: rollback action started: config-service:reconcile (change id cfg-2026-324). Rolling back schema-defaults to previous behavior.

Matt (sre): I also put a temporary guard in the routing layer to prefer region-affinity: /opt/routing/bin/ctl set affinity-strict=true for the canary routes.

Sara (product): Noting customer impact: ACME and BetaCorp experienced elevated error rates and longer tail latencies for ~18 minutes. ACME consumer-facing requests had ~52% 5xx rate peak. We should prepare an incident summary for both.

Cheng (runtime): Monitoring shows fallback events dropped from ~420/min to ~3/min within 45s of the changes. p50 latency for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 dropped from 420ms -> 125ms; p95 dropped from 1.8s -> 320ms. Will keep monitoring.

Alex (support): Sent update to ACME explaining we mitigated and are doing a root cause + postmortem. They asked for model fidelity checks and a guarantee that pinned variants won't be auto-replaced.

Ana (oncall): Handoff: I'm handing off to Matt for full post-incident operations and follow-ups. Matt, you have the pager from 03:00 UTC. :handshake:

Matt (sre): Taking it. Next steps: 1) revert migration that removed deprecated mapping or make reader respect legacy field mapping, 2) add a canary + test that ensures pinned variant invariants, 3) expand telemetry to surface variant-change events per-tenant.

Cheng (runtime): I'll own the quick patch to the reader to prefer explicit legacy fields when present and add a unit test. Plan to push a safe config update within the hour.

deploy-bot: config-service:reconcile completed. change cfg-2026-324 rolled back to previous default. No further automatic cross-region fallbacks scheduled.

Ana (oncall): Verified with metrics dashboard, loops stopped. :thumbsup:

Sara (product): Assigning postmortem to Cheng + Matt, due EOD. Notify support to run regression checks for all pinned-variant tenants.

Matt (sre): Filing INC-2589007 in tracker, severity P1 -> mitigated. Will include timeline and customer impact in the doc.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2589007 status -> mitigated (watching); assignees: Matt, Cheng; followups required: postmortem, automated tests for schema migrations, alerts for sudden variant swaps. Close once postmortem linked.

Ana (oncall): Good job y'all. I'll keep monitoring for 30m then sign off.

(END OF THREAD)
